description: This file implements package management functionalities such as installation, uninstallation, validation, dependency handling, registry management, and console output utilities for an agent-based software system. It includes structures for package metadata, environment variables, and runtime info, along with CLI spinner animations and color-coded status indicators. The key features involve validating package contents, copying files, setting up Python virtual environments, managing dependencies, updating a local registry, and providing user guidance during package operations.

classes.name: UserEnvironmentVar
classes.description: Represents a user-configurable environment variable with name, description, type, default value, optional flag, and validation pattern.

classes.name: UserEnvironmentConfig
classes.description: Holds collections of required and optional environment variables for user configuration.

classes.name: PackageMetadata
classes.description: Contains metadata for a package including name, version, author, dependencies, capabilities, user environment variables, and source info.

classes.name: AgentNodeConfig
classes.description: Configuration data specific to an agent node, including node ID and default port.

classes.name: DependencyConfig
classes.description: Lists dependencies for Python packages and system packages.

classes.name: CapabilityConfig
classes.description: Defines agent node capabilities such as reasoners and skills.

classes.name: FunctionInfo
classes.description: Describes a function (reasoner or skill) with its name and description.

classes.name: InstallationRegistry
classes.description: Represents the registry of installed packages with a mapping by package name.

classes.name: InstalledPackage
classes.description: Details of an installed package including name, version, path, source, runtime info, and status.

classes.name: RuntimeInfo
classes.description: Runtime state information of an installed package such as PID, port, start time, and log file path.

classes.name: PackageInstaller
classes.description: Handles the installation process of packages including validation, copying, dependency installation, and registry updates.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: CLI spinner indicator class for progress feedback.

classes.name: PackageUninstaller
classes.description: Manages uninstallation, including stopping running services and cleaning up files and registry entries.

methods.name: newSpinner
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new CLI spinner instance.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops spinner animation and clears the line.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Stops spinner and displays a success message.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Stops spinner and displays an error message.

methods.name: InstallPackage
methods.description: Orchestrates the entire package installation process, including validation, copying, dependency installation, registry update, and user guidance.

methods.name: checkEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Checks for missing required environment variables and suggests commands to set them, also displays optional variables with defaults.

methods.name: UninstallPackage
methods.description: Handles package removal, including stopping services, deleting files, and updating the registry.

methods.name: stopAgentNode
methods.description: Terminates a running agent node process by PID.

methods.name: loadRegistry
methods.description: Loads the installation registry from YAML file.

methods.name: saveRegistry
methods.description: Persists the current registry state to YAML file.

methods.name: validatePackage
methods.description: Checks for essential package files like 'agentfield-package.yaml' and 'main.py'.

methods.name: parsePackageMetadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package metadata from 'agentfield-package.yaml'.

methods.name: isPackageInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a package is already installed based on registry.

methods.name: copyPackage
methods.description: Recursively copies source package files to target directory.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies individual files from source to destination.

methods.name: installDependencies
methods.description: Installs Python and system dependencies specified in package metadata and requirements files.

methods.name: hasRequirementsFile
methods.description: Checks if a requirements.txt exists in the package directory.

methods.name: updateRegistry
methods.description: Updates the YAML registry with a new package entry, ensuring logs directory exists and paths are set.
